title.narrative: Significant progress has been made in strengthening the capacities of government and partners at national and sub-national levels to design and implement innovative, climate-resilient WASH solutions. This has led to optimal investments, ensuring quality, inclusive, and safely managed WASH services in targeted poor communities, schools, and health centres in rural, underserved areas. Over 1 million people have been reached with climate-resilient WASH services through the provision of water and sanitation infrastructure and hygiene promotion in regular and emergency contexts.
